QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Masquerations
QuestInfo.0: The Masked Gentleman needs your help to fix up decorations for the masquerade.
QuestInfo.1: The Masked Gentleman has requested a new jack-o-lantern to replace the one that was destroyed by zombies. Keep an eye out for a suitable Halloween Pumpkin while you're out on the field.
QuestInfo.2: You brought some pumpkins to the Masked Gentleman! The masquerade is looking good!

0.0: Those cursed undead hooligans! It's vandalism! I should call the ghoul police!\nAll of my pumpkins are shattered to bits, and for what?! Zombies don't even EAT pumpkins. This is just going to ruin the night. Don't you think it'll ruin the night? Don't you?!

yes.0: See? Night ruined! Go get me more pumpkins.

no.0: You heartless monster! You're not invited to my masquerade ball anymore. I don't know that we're still HOLDING the masquerade, but you're definitely not invited.

1.0: I'll have my staff begin jack-o-lanterning these immediately. Night unruined!

yes.0: Thank you for taking the time to be my pumpkin hound. You'll find a small gift in your inventory.

item.0: This is not enough pumpkins! This is not enough pumpkins at all!
